name: BattleTech Trading Card Game
customHelp: BattleTech TCG phases: Untap, Draw 2, Deploy, Repair/Reload, Missions, End. Draw 5 cards to begin. Damage to a Stockpile scraps that many cards; a player wins when an opponent's Stockpile is empty. Editable precon import links: https://github.com/Nathan-Culver/TCG-Arena-BT/blob/main/BattleTech_Precon_Import_Links.md Draft and Sealed setup guide: https://github.com/Nathan-Culver/TCG-Arena-BT/blob/main/BattleTech_Limited_Setup.md

mulliganCycle.info: BattleTech TCG Mulligan: You may mulligan only when your current opening hand contains exactly 0 or 1 Resource cards. Reshuffle your entire hand and draw one fewer card. Check the same eligibility condition again before taking another mulligan.
London Mulligan: Draw five cards again each time you mulligan. When you keep, put one card on the bottom of your deck for each mulligan you took.

postMulligan.info: Select one card for each mulligan you took, then put the selected cards on the bottom of your deck.
